mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equities, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS is falling, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.5%, persistent inflation pressures prompt central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC for the signal is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher interest rates reduce equity valuations and slow economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate expanding consumer demand and economic activity, which consistently drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of months with rising HOUST, or Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a supply contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods with INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC for the signal is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as production disruptions lower corporate earnings and increase inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods with INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
